cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(tramuntana_fw)

target_sources(app PRIVATE
  src/main.c
  src/usb.c
  src/port.c
  src/board.c
  src/display.c
  src/proto.c
  src/spi.c
  src/i2c.c
  src/scope.c
  src/awg.c
  src/pwm.c
  src/logic.c
  src/bridge.c
  src/arena.c
  src/dmaring.c
  src/shell_cmds.c
  src/watch.c
  src/emu.c
  src/seq.c
  src/stamp.c
)

# images_gen.h / font_gen.h, generated by fw/imgs/convert_images.py and
# fw/imgs/font_gen.py.
target_include_directories(app PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../imgs)
